overview_description.description: Dock is the AI revenue enablement platform that gives revenue teams real-time guidance across the entire customer lifecycle. Collaborative workspaces help sellers and customer success teams work directly with buyers—from early deal conversations to onboarding and renewal—while an AI-powered content library, learning tools, and document generation keep reps equipped in the flow of work. The result: faster sales cycles, higher win rates, and more predictable onboarding.
